title: Past extraterrestrial presence on the Moon and Mars

tellings.quote: I think that the inference to the best explanation of this cumulative data is that there was a past extraterrestrial presence of some kind or another on the moon and on Mars in the solar system more broadly.

plain: Something extraterrestrial was once present on the Moon and on Mars, says a researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani. He tells Michels it is his own reading: the best explanation for all the evidence added together, which he does not list in this passage. If he is right, someone not from Earth was active in our solar system in the past.
